# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made in the latest release of SwifterSwift. Update to the newest 9.x version to receive them.

If you copied an extension into your project rather than adding the package, you won't receive fixes automatically. Compare your copy with the latest version of its file in this repository.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report security vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions or pull requests.

Report them privately instead:

- through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/SwifterSwift/SwifterSwift/security/advisories/new) (**Security › Report a vulnerability**), or
- by email to [omaralbeik@gmail.com](mailto:omaralbeik@gmail.com).

Include the affected extension, the SwifterSwift version, the platform, and steps or code to reproduce the issue. You'll get a reply as soon as possible; once the issue is confirmed, a fix is released and the reporter is credited unless they prefer otherwise.
